# Arbitrary FPT dependence can be diagonalized uniformly

30 October 2026. A strengthening of PACKED_GUARD_THEOREM Sections 7--8:
the computational negative needs only absence of SUBEXPONENTIAL-time
constant-advantage NC1-PRF distinguishers, not a single fixed exponential
security exponent. The source/guard/control program is unchanged. No new
numerical case, query experiment, or cryptographic instance is involved.

## 1. Explicit weaker premise

Keep the polynomial-time key generation, public template, polynomial key
length and fixed-key NC1 evaluation assumptions in the main proof. Replace
its security premise E by Esub:

    Every uniform classical randomized membership-oracle algorithm with
    time2^{o(n)} has distinguishing advantage<1/20 at every sufficiently
    large n (with its own cutoff).

This is still a quantitative cryptographic premise, stronger than ordinary
polynomial security. E implies Esub. The main proof's specified D4 premise
therefore supplies Esub too; ordinary qualitative LPN/DDH does not.
No arbitrary-FPT impossibility follows from polynomial security alone.

## 2. Pay the evaluation of the arbitrary parameter function

Suppose a uniform FPT learner exists with a COMPUTABLE integer bound

    f(d)*(T+alpha+L_in+1)^c                                       (1)

for fixed epsilon=1/64 and delta=1/3, including its standalone student's
one-output generation cost. The degree c is an absolute integer. Replace
f by a larger positive integer function if needed. The adversary may hardcode
the learner, c, and a program computing this witness bound f; existence of
such a program is part of the standard FPT definition. It is not supplied
to the learner as a scientific oracle.

For payload length n put B_n=2^{floor(sqrt(n))}. For EVERY integer
1<=p<=floor(sqrt(n)), run the program for f(2p+9) for at most B_n steps.
Call p qualified if it halts within that budget and its output is at most
B_n. Choose the largest qualified p; use p=1 if none qualify. Denote the
choice by p_n. This whole search costs at most sqrt(n)*B_n=2^{o(n)} steps,
even if some f computations are exceptionally inefficient. In particular
it does not assume that computing f(d) is polynomial in its value.

For EACH fixed p, both the value f(2p+9) and its computation time are finite.
Thus that p qualifies at every sufficiently large n. Consequently

    p_n -> infinity,     p_n<=sqr

# Constant-TV approximate probability rank cannot supply FPT acquisition

30 October 2026. Unconditional representation theorem. This is NOT a
computational lower bound on every nonlinear learner. It complements the
explicitly conditional PACKED_GUARD_THEOREM.md and uses the same source.

## 1. A nonnegative matrix lemma

Let D_N be the uniform diagonal law on [N]x[N]. If a nonnegative matrix B
has total mass1 and TV(B,D_N)<=eta, then

    rank(B)>=(1-6*eta)*N.                                          (1)

Indeed the diagonal deficit sum_i(1/N-B_ii)_+ is at most eta, and the
total off-diagonal mass is at most eta. Fewer than2*eta*N indices have
B_ii<1/(2N). At most4*eta*N rows have off-diagonal sum>1/(4N). On the
remaining at least(1-6*eta)*N indices the corresponding principal
submatrix is strictly row-diagonally dominant: its diagonal is at least
1/(2N), while its restricted off-diagonal row sum is at most1/(4N).
It is nonsingular. One direct proof is to select a largest-modulus
coordinate of a putative nonzero null vector and compare that row.
No symmetry, PSD, or bounded matrix conditioning is assumed.

## 2. Use the packed source without any cryptography

Fix packing p and let n=p*s grow through its positive multiples, n>=2.
Use the source in PACKED_GUARD_THEOREM Sections2--4 with the public read
schedule1,2,...,n and EVERY permutation the identity. Thus L=n, m=n*s,
all hidden Boolean computation is absent, and q_acc can be chosen0.
The proof of exact cut-logit rank<=d=2p+9 and magnitude<=T is unchanged.
Supply alpha=d*T+1. The source is fully supported and rational.

The first input word X is uniform in{0,1}^n. Every block is scanned at
least once. From the future scan tape extract a word Y by retaining the
FIRST scan of each of the p blocks in order. This is a fixed deterministic
map of the future alone. By the same copy union bound,

    TV(P_(X,Y),D_(2^n)) <=e_n :=m*2^[-2(n^2+1)].                   (2)

In particular e_n<1/64. The output label and all padding can be discarded;
no fact about their distribution is needed for(2).

# ROOT28 result: a parameterized source obstruction, not another rank lift

30 October 2026. Mathematical construction completed; public priority UNKNOWN.

The packed squared-residual source in PACKED_GUARD_THEOREM.md stores s input
bits per coordinate, with d=2p+9, and verifies every repeated scan by a
nonnegative integer square. All fixed-token updates remain linear in the
lifted state, including every inconsistent prefix. Its full-future centered
logit rank is at most d, |ell|<=T, alpha=dT+1, and

    log2 T =2n/p+O(log n).

This is not the previous n+O(1)-rank linear mismatch guard. Native arbitrary
prefix queries are uniformly simulated by at most one ordinary Boolean
membership query and polynomial(n) work, with negligible transcript error.
The actual meaningful label occupies almost all generated mass.

Under the explicitly stated exponentially secure NC1 PRF premise E, no
classical learner with cost f(d)*poly(T,alpha) can return a standalone
constant-TV sampler in full generality. In fact f(d)*(T+alpha)^{o(d)} is
excluded. The proof fixes p AFTER the hypothetical algorithm's degree,
then lets n grow, so it handles ARBITRARY f(d). The preceding polynomial-
security growing-rank PRF barrier alone did not imply this result.
Section10 supplies an explicit instantiation from subexponential finite-
field DDH hardness D4, using the actual quantitative Naor--Reingold
reduction plus a separately proved one-bit hash bound. These are assumed
hardness premises, not unconditional theorems or computationally tested facts.

SUBEXP_FPT_REDUCTION.md further weakens the premise to absence of uniform
2^{o(n)}-time NC1-PRF distinguishers: it clocks the COMPUTATION of the
arbitrary computable parameter bound, then chooses packing p_n growing
slowly enough that f(2p_n+9)<=2^{sqrt(n)}. This yields the same conditional
negative with no free inverse-growth function or nonuniform advice. No
ordinary polynomial-security premise is promoted to that stronger claim.

Independently, REPRESENTATION_BARRIER.md proves UNCONDITIONALLY that some
such sources have no constant-TV global surrogate of probability rank
f(d)*poly(T,alpha). The same obstruction applies to independent cutwise
nonnegative probability-row shadows under P-prefix-average L1 error.
The argument uses a near-uniform diagonal copy marginal and strict
diagonal dominance, avoiding exact-rank/ill-conditioning artifacts.
